A.name: Cluster A — profitable disciplined realization
A.shared: consistent realized profit, multiple completed exits, near-zero re-entry (no FOMO), diversified, no severe long-held loser, no concentration
A.metrics: P1: +$1,769 @ 0.78 PnL coverage, 36 exits, re-entry rate 0.08; P3: +$89 @ 0.12 coverage, 3 exits, 0 re-entries
A.whyNoneFit: Sisyphus rewards stagnation (these wallets progress), Midas rewards UNREALIZED holdings (these realize), Newton/Icarus require re-entry/giveback (absent by discipline), Caesar/Croesus require concentration/size (absent by diversification), DQ/Napoleon require losses (absent)
A.missingConcept: a persona for taking profits well: frequent meaningful realized gains, low higher-price re-entry, limited giveback, not dependent on concentration

B.name: Cluster B — diversified accumulator / many-bet sampler
B.shared: systematic diversified buying (17-259 tokens), zero completed exit cycles, zero re-entries, no concentration in any single asset
B.metrics: T9: 259 tokens/0 exits; M4/M5/M6: buy-only, no sells; P4: partial-profit harvesting without full exits (+$88 realized)
B.whyNoneFit: Caesar is the anti-shape (single-bag concentration), Sisyphus needs grind-to-zero cycles (no exits exist), Midas needs profitable open holdings with current value (unpriced), Newton/DQ/Icarus need exit behavior that never occurs
B.missingConcept: a persona for spread-many-bets accumulation: many small diversified positions, patient holding, no disposal discipline implied
B.caveat: partial-history caveat: with a 1,000-tx cap, 'never exits' is observed only within the window; longer histories could reveal disposal
